{{Otheruses|unidentified dealer}}
{{Conjecture}}
A '''dealer''' sold the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] an [[Ayalayli thornwood/Legends|Ayalayli thornwood]]-framed [[Gong/Legends|gong]] and swore that the piece had been used in the [[Parliament of Moralan]],<ref name="TPMVDE">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the government of the [[Moralan (species)|Moralan]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Droids">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> which the Hutts had driven to [[Death/Legends|extinction]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> The gong became one of Jabba's favorite conversation pieces, and he used it to signal the beginning of the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TPMVDE" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NERC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The dealer was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TPMVDE" />
